notes: archive: fig2a_MSC30_77K_ads_lowP.json. Digitized 0.0165 MPa (x10 = bar), 6.446 mmol g-1 (figure axis unit); wt% = W1 computed from mmol g-1. Marker straddles the y axis and is crossed by fit lines; digitized with a tighter region and wider colour tolerance (see archive). isotherm_point_count 16 = 11 adsorption + 5 desorption pressure steps stated in the Experimental section (p. 25914); low-pressure markers overlap on the plot. H2: Micromeritics HPVA II high-pressure volumetric device; ~1.2 g sample ("about 1.2 g") in a 10 cm3 cell; outgassed under vacuum (6 x 10^-4 Pa) at 423 K for 10 h (degas 423 K = 149.85 C); "The contribution of the empty cell was systematically measured at each temperature and subtracted" - how the free (dead) volume was determined is not stated, so calibration_described = false. source_location: main p. 25917 (page image main-06), Fig. 2a (MSC30), 153 K series, filled dark-blue circles (adsorption), highest-pressure point
notes: archive: fig2a_MSC30_153K_ads_highestP.json. Digitized 14.2100 MPa (x10 = bar), 15.341 mmol g-1 (figure axis unit); wt% = W1 computed from mmol g-1. Only the highest-pressure point of this non-77 K isotherm is extracted (protocol scope). isotherm_point_count 16 = 11 adsorption + 5 desorption pressure steps stated in the Experimental section (p. 25914); low-pressure markers overlap on the plot. H2: Micromeritics HPVA II high-pressure volumetric device; ~1.2 g sample ("about 1.2 g") in a 10 cm3 cell; outgassed under vacuum (6 x 10^-4 Pa) at 423 K for 10 h (degas 423 K = 149.85 C); "The contribution of the empty cell was systematically measured at each temperature and subtracted" - how the free (dead) volume was determined is not stated, so calibration_described = false. Adsorption pressure steps 0.1, 0.5, 0.8, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7.5, 10, 12.5, 14 MPa; desorption 11.5, 8, 4.5, 1.5, 0.5 MPa. Characterization from Table 1 (p. 25916). BET range: 0.01-0.05 (relative pressures, "according to Rouquerol [47]"; ref. 47 is Rouquerol et al., "Is the BET equation applicable to microporous adsorbents?", coded as consistency criteria stated). BET probe gas coded N2: the paper describes N2 adsorption at 77 K and CO2 at 273 K for textural characterisation and BET over P/P0 0.01-0.05. Pore volumes (Vtot, Vmicro, Vmeso) and Smicro are 2D-NLDFT HS (SAIEUS) from combined N2 and CO2 isotherms (pore_volume_probe_gas = other). Average micropore size: Table 1 attributes it to "Dubinin-Radushkevich and Stoeckli [61]" while the Experimental text says L0 "was calculated using the NLDFT model"; method coded unspecified.
